title: Every bad element of an array is reported, not just the first
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

explanation.approach: Index `1` (the number) and index `3` (the boolean) are both wrong, and both come back — `map` runs `check` against every element independently before the results are flattened together.

snippets.label: Every bad element of an array is reported, not just the first

expect.output: ["tags[1] must be a String", "tags[3] must be a String"]

snippets.note: Index `1` (the number) and index `3` (the boolean) are both wrong, and both come back — `map` runs `check` against every element independently before the results are flattened together.
